Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

dlsrules 2026-10-09

rfb rounding option (October 2026, branch iag)

  • rfb_rule() and rfb_advice() take digits, the rounding of the shown components (index A and B, ratio, last index value, I_trigger and I_loss, advice change). The advice is computed from unrounded values as before. The defaults are the old ones; c(index = 4, ratio = 4, index_value = 3, change = 2) reproduces the sea urchin rfb_rule_round() table (191-urx), whose relative CPUE index is near 1.

AI use: Claude (Anthropic) wrote this option, its test and this entry (12 October 2026); nobody has reviewed it yet.

Harvest rate x index rule of the shrimp stocks (October 2026, branch iag)

  • New hr_index_advice(): advice = HR proxy x latest survey index, with a biomass safeguard at I_trigger and no precautionary multiplier, the rule of the Icelandic shrimp stocks (chr_advice() applies the K-based multiplier and stops when K < 0.32). Options reproduce the old scripts: binary or unapplied safeguard (safeguard), safeguard before or after the stability clause (safeguard_step), the stability clause’s limits, threshold and direction (stability_limits, stability_threshold, stability_when), setting the advice to the limit (stability_set), and the old advice-change formula (change = "new"). With the Arnarfjordur options it gives the published 2026 advice (248.082 t) and the old script’s result for any index and previous advice (tests).
  • hr_index_advice(apply_safeguard = FALSE): b is computed as safeguard says and shown in the table, but not applied (the old Isafjardardjup and Snaefellsnes scripts: binary b, not applied). With change = "previous" the change from a previous advice of 0 is NA (undefined; the old Isafjardardjup table), not Inf/NaN. With the Isafjardardjup options the old script’s lines give 0 t in 2026 (0.5 x 267 = 133.5 t, capped at 1.2 x 0 by the leftover clause), the same as the published rule.
  • Correction (lead, October 2026): the published inshore shrimp rule has no stability clause. Arnarfjordur and Isafjardardjup use A = I x HR x b with the binary safeguard (safeguard = "binary", no stability_limits), which reproduces their published advice (Isafjardardjup 2021-2026 exactly, Arnarfjordur 2016-2026 within later index revisions). The clause and apply_safeguard = FALSE options describe leftover lines of the old scripts and are kept for comparison only.

AI use: Claude (Anthropic) wrote this function, its tests and this entry (12 October 2026); nobody has reviewed them yet.

Helpers shared by the MFRI category 3 stock assessments (rfb: 13-cas, 14-mon, 24-lem, 25-wit, 26-meg, 27-dab, 60-norway-redfish; chr: 04-whg), which had their own copies of them. The stock repositories call them with their stock-specific choices as arguments; on the same data they give the same numbers as the copies they replace.

New functions

  • Length distributions: catch_ldist() reads the catch length distributions for the rule from a pax database (lengths rounded, counts not raised a second time; pax is in Suggests and only this function needs it); rule_ldist() selects the gears, years and lengths of the rule from a collected distribution and can add other distributions (e.g. survey lengths in years without catch samples).
  • Fishing pressure: mean_length_above() (L_mean above L_c), fproxy_series() (f and the F proxy L_F=M / L_mean by year, with the years as arguments), harvest_rate_proxy() (the chr harvest rate proxy) and linf_from_catch().
  • I_loss and I_trigger: index_series(), calc_iloss() with the method "min", "second_min", "mean" or "fixed", and ref_points_iloss().
  • History and tables: assessment_summary() (log-normal or normal intervals), advice_hist_rows() and rfb_ref_points_table().
  • Rule wrappers: rfb_advice() and chr_advice() cut the index at the assessment year, run rfb_rule() / fproxy_rule() and return the prognosis with lower-case component names and the assessment year.

Other changes

  • calc_Itrigger() gains factor (default 1.4, as before).
  • target_reference_length() (L_F=M) has its own help page again.
  • dplyr is now imported; tests (testthat) added.

dlsrules 2022-05-31 (2bbde3c, September 2026)

  • rfb_rule() stops when K >= 0.32 and computes the target reference length from Linf and Lc (a target_reference_length element of ref_points is no longer used); fproxy_rule() stops when K < 0.32 or K >= 0.45; calc_ratio() needs five years of index; multiplier_lookup() stops when K >= 0.45.
